errors.text: The specific AlCoCrFeNi2.1 as-cast FCC+B2 eutectic HEA is replaced by a generic as-quenched supersaturated precipitation-hardening alloy.

The predicted transition is formulated primarily versus aging time at one temperature rather than versus the critical aging-temperature window, including embrittlement near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.
The essential jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary mediator and crack initiation at jagged boundary tips are omitted.
Ductility recovery is attributed to precipitate coarsening, coherency loss, and Orowan looping rather than reduced L12 ordering and formation of ductile phase-boundary transition zones.
